acceptance: Core and Full taxonomies cover the ADR's relational, window, statistical, approximate, semi-structured, temporal, recursive, lateral, grouping, and applied-analysis requirements.
Every candidate scored query maps to at least one capability leaf and one declared root lineage; related lineages are summed across every block for the effective-weight audit.
Each proposed leaf is assigned to a fixture, explicitly excluded with weight reallocation, or moved to a separately named extension before freeze.
The matrix reports uncovered, duplicate, and overrepresented capability leaves.
A candidate TPC-Havoc panel covers distinct transformation families without weighting duplicate variants.
One explicit leaf/lineage allocation demonstrates across-block arithmetic for the <=40% lineage, <=15% benchmark, >=25% real-data, and >=15% advanced-SQL guardrails; all weights remain provisional.
context: Implements the proposed cross-benchmark score architecture. Preserve official TPC metrics as separate outputs. Numerical weights, size vectors, concurrency points, thresholds, and the M4 reference remain pilot hypotheses until methodology freeze.
description: Define analytics-core-v1 and analytics-full-v1 as versioned capability taxonomies. Map candidate queries to capability leaves and source-lineage groups, identify gaps, and produce a candidate TPC-Havoc and advanced-function panel under explicit coverage and runtime budgets.
